recommendation: Revise the artifact to name an attributable owner for the charge operation, restore the complete repository-precedence hierarchy including distinct Wiki tiers and History, and define the AdmissionBundle authority, validator, and exact prepare command; submit the corrected artifact through a new review run.

findings.claim: The design mandates that every mutable mission-control artifact have exactly one declared owner and write mechanism, yet the charge/boundary record - the sole mandatory pre-charge write - is assigned to 'the owning charge operation', an operation the design elsewhere states is not identified by any pinned Source of Truth; the mandatory pre-charge control surface therefore has no existing owner, and closing it requires inventing the capability the design forbids.

locator.value: 10. Generated and mutable mission-control ownership policy

findings.disposition_reason: The parent-confirmed high-severity finding establishes that the charge/boundary record has no existing attributable owner for the owning charge operation.

findings.claim: The design claims to follow repository precedence but collapses the pinned content hierarchy Project Wiki, Local Wiki, Common Wiki and History into one post-skills 'Wiki' tier and drops History entirely, so precedence for wiki-tier or History conflicts is undeclared while the design asserts the pinned order governs.
findings.disposition_reason: The parent-confirmed medium-severity finding establishes that the repository-precedence paraphrase collapses Wiki tiers and omits History.

findings.claim: The design introduces the new persisted contract identifier 'gat-admission-bundle/1' with new fields and delegates the bundle to a 'read-only prepare operation', but names no owning schema authority, validator or exact command, so the schema-validation half of the required dual validation has no declared owner and the P1/P2 evidence cannot cite a validatable contract.
findings.disposition_reason: The parent-confirmed medium-severity finding establishes that the proposed AdmissionBundle schema lacks a named authority, validator, and exact prepare command.

residual_risks: The charge/boundary record remains without an attributable owning charge-operation owner until revision.
Repository precedence remains incomplete while Wiki tiers are collapsed and History is omitted.
AdmissionBundle preparation remains underspecified without a named authority, validator, and exact command.
Prompt-only restriction mode limits assurance that reviewer restrictions were enforced.
